definitions.explanation: The warhead portion of a nuclear weapon — the part containing the fissile or fusion material that delivers the explosive yield. Typically used in news, policy, and security contexts when discussing missiles that carry nuclear payloads.

examples.japanese: {核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搭載|とうさい}→搭載：12789_tousai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧。
examples.english: A missile loaded with a nuclear warhead.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数|すう}{百|ひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧{発|ぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保有|ほゆう}→保有：11615_hoyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That country possesses several hundred nuclear warheads.

examples.japanese: {新条約|しんじょうやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと、⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実戦配備|じっせんはいび}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Under the new treaty, the two countries agreed to reduce the number of deployed nuclear warheads.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧ (nuclear, from ⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧ "nuclear weapon") and {弾頭|だんとう} (warhead, literally "tip/head of a projectile"). The word refers specifically to the warhead — the part of the missile that actually detonates — rather than the delivery vehicle (missile, bomber, submarine) itself.

USAGE:
- Most often counted with the counter ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (rounds): ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{発|ぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核弾頭|かくだんとう} (ten nuclear warheads).
- Appears constantly in newspaper articles about arms control, proliferation, and security policy.
- A single missile can carry multiple warheads — referred to as {多弾頭|ただんとう} (multiple warheads) or MIRVs in English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搭載|とうさい}→搭載：12789_tousai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to load/mount a nuclear warhead
- {核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保有|ほゆう}→保有：11615_hoyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to possess nuclear warheads
- {核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to reduce nuclear warheads
- {核弾頭|かくだんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配備|はいび}→配備：25292_haibi⟧: deployment of nuclear warheads
- {実戦配備|じっせんはいび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核弾頭|かくだんとう}: operationally deployed nuclear warheads

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧: nuclear weapon — the broader term covering warheads and delivery systems
- {弾頭|だんとう}: warhead — the generic term, not necessarily nuclear
- ⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧: missile — the delivery vehicle
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧: nuclear — used as a prefix in many compounds ({核実験|かくじっけん} "nuclear test," {核保有国|かくほゆうこく} "nuclear-weapon state")
- ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧: atomic bomb — a historical/specific term often referring to the bombs dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki
